expectations.text: Identifies this as a saturator over an UNKNOWN-size set (finding the members IS the work; not enumerable up front)
expectations.evidence: Response makes the set enumerable up front, opposite of the assertion: 'The set of ways this codebase writes to a log is finite and enumerable' and 'over a finite, fully-enumerated set of log call sites. The finiteness of the sink surface is the lever that turns "find everything" from hopeless into measurable.' Its core move is 'enumerate the sinks.'

expectations.text: Uses heterogeneous finders / multiple distinct search lenses rather than a single grep or one-shot search
expectations.evidence: 'Layer independent detectors (taint, heuristics, literals, runtime NER) so their union maximizes recall'; each has 'a different false-negative profile'; explicitly rejects single-grep: 'The mistake most PII scans make is to search for PII (grep ... regex) ... We invert it.'

expectations.text: Adversarially verifies each candidate with a separate agent (tries to refute it) before it counts as a finding
expectations.evidence: Not present. Verification is confidence tiers ('high = taint source->sink ... medium = heuristic') and static<->runtime cross-check (corroboration/ground truth), not a separate agent adversarially trying to refute each candidate before it counts.

expectations.text: Stop rule is K consecutive dry rounds with no new confirmed findings, and dedups against everything SEEN (not just confirmed)
expectations.evidence: Stop rule is coverage-anchored ('sink-surface coverage = 100%; canary recall >= target; marginal detector yield flat over the last N sweeps ...'); dedup is 'fingerprint = (file, sink, pii-class, detector)' / 'the same site isn't re-reported' -- not an explicit 'dedup against everything SEEN (not just confirmed)' mechanism.

expectations.text: Does NOT model the task as a fixed queue or a one-pass search that stops after looking once
expectations.evidence: 'Autonomy = three cadences (PR gate, nightly sweep, always-on runtime monitor)'; 'this confidence is maintained, not just achieved once'; 'the runtime monitor and canaries never stop' -- not a one-pass/fixed-queue model.
